subject: Evaluation success signals, escape hatches & acceptance checks for Novamed pilot
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@novamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Todd Nguyen <todd.nguyen@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Align on evaluation success signals and acceptance checks

Hi Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our leadership needs a short, actionable checklist we can use to decide whether the pilot meets Novamed's bar for production readiness. Procurement asked for the acceptance criteria so they can align legal/ops on the timeline.

High-level asks from our side:
- Clear pass/fail thresholds for latency, throughput, and accuracy for the core extraction flow.
- A short list of smoke tests (happy path + 3 edge cases) that we can run during the final week.
- Defined owners for each acceptance item and an escape-hatch plan in case a high‑severity blocker appears.

I attached a basic MAP template (Novamed_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short doc with suggested smoke cases (smoke-tests-and-edgecases.md). Can you confirm whether the timelines below are realistic?

Target timeline:
- Final acceptance kit to us by Friday (2025-07-03)
- Evidence run (customer-run smoke tests) week of 2025-07-07
- Go/no-go review with Novamed execs on 2025-07-11

We also need a short list of what evidence you’ll provide (logs, audit traces, example inputs/outputs).

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Cole
Director, Automation Programs
Novamed

Attachments: Novamed_MAP_v1.xlsx; smoke-tests-and-edgecases.md

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on evaluation success signals and acceptance checks

Erin — thanks for the clear asks and the templates. Quick read-through below and proposed owners / thresholds so we can lock the MAP this week.

Proposed success signals (candidate list) — we’ll narrow to the top 6 for the acceptance kit:
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 450ms for the extraction endpoint at expected pilot concurrency (30 rps).
2) Throughput: sustained 25 rps for 5 minutes without error-rate > 0.5%.
3) Extraction accuracy: weighted F1 >= 0.88 on the Novamed validation set.
4) Stability: no memory growth > 3% per hour during a 4 hr soak.
5) Cost signal: per-request inference cost <= $0.06 (config-dependent).
6) Observability: full request trace with token-level timing and error breadcrumbs for every failed request.

Escape hatch and failover plan (short):
- If accuracy < 0.82 during evidence run -> immediate rollback to previous model variant; schedule remediation sprint (owner: Product — Marissa).
- If latency or error-rate violates SLOs during peak -> fallback routing to a lighter model variant + notify both teams (owner: Infra — Ben).
- If data leakage or audit concern -> pause inbound traffic, preserve full trace bundle, and run joint incident review (owner: Security Ops — Karthik).

Owners (proposed):
- Acceptance coordinator / evidence owner: Erin (Novamed) + Marissa (Redwood)
- Runtime & latency: Ben Carter
- Model quality & test harness: Marissa Cole
- Security & audit evidence: Karthik Iyer

Evidence we will provide (short list): logs (request/response), token-timing traces, model version manifest, sample input-output pairs, system resource metrics, SOC2 checklist entries relevant to evaluation. We can bundle the final evidence as a zip (final-evidence-pack.zip).

Next steps:
1) Ben and Marissa to confirm observability hooks and smoke-test steps by end of day tomorrow (2025-07-01).
2) We deliver the finalized acceptance kit to Novamed by 2025-07-03.
3) Customer-run evidence week of 2025-07-07; joint review 2025-07-11.

I’m attaching a revised MAP skeleton and will drop a short PR to the shared drive once Ben confirms instrumentation.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of North America GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin.cole@novamed.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align on evaluation success signals and acceptance checks

Karthik / Marissa — quick notes on the instrumentation and thresholds.

On the latency/throughput side:
- I can commit to the observability hooks (token-level timing + request id propagation). We’ll add an endpoint to export 95/99 latency samples to the evidence bundle.
- For the throughput test, recommend a two-step: (a) short burst at target concurrency to validate SLOs, (b) 30-minute soak at reduced concurrency to validate stability. That gives us better signal than a 5-minute run.

On accuracy and smoke tests:
- The weighted F1 >= 0.88 is OK as a stretch target; for contractual acceptance I recommend >= 0.85 as the pass threshold and a remediation band between 0.82–0.85 that triggers a prioritized fix plan (not an immediate fail).

Observability caveat: we need Novamed to whitelist our tracing domain for their test environment so traces flow through — Erin, can procurement confirm that by Friday? If not, we’ll provide a reduced evidence set (logs + sample IO) but no full trace bundle.

I’ve added a short checklist to the shared drive indicating the exact artifacts we’ll produce. Will drop the link and the minimal test-run commands by EOD.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@novamed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-01T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP items and owners — Novamed pilot acceptance timeline

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the final decisions so Novamed procurement has one doc to act on.

Confirmed acceptance & cutover timeline:
- Redwood to deliver finalized acceptance kit (MAP + artifacts list + smoke test scripts): 2025-07-03 (owner: Karthik / Marissa).
- Novamed to run evidence and return results: 2025-07-07 through 2025-07-10 (owner: Erin).
- Joint go/no-go review: 2025-07-11 at 10:00 PT (decision owners: Erin + Novamed execs; Redwood execs: Karthik + Marissa).

Final pass/fail bands:
- Acceptance pass: weighted F1 >= 0.85 AND 95p latency < 450ms.
- Remediation band: F1 0.82–0.85 OR 95p latency between 450–600ms -> joint remediation plan, target fix window 2 weeks.
- Fail: F1 < 0.82 OR sustained error rate > 1% during evidence run -> pause and remediation.

Attachments: final MAP skeleton (I uploaded as final-evidence-pack.zip to the shared drive) and a brief acceptance-run checklist.

Erin — if procurement confirms trace whitelisting and the target timeline looks good, I’ll publish the MAP to the shared folder and mark the owners in the acceptance matrix.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
